escenas.texto: Which was the most commented video in Oceania this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, bro what did i just play, by Kubz Scouts, with over 1 thousand comments.
In second place, I strongly recommend: Phantom Blade Zero (Review), by Skill Up, with over 2 thousand comments.
And number one: How Are These People Real, by Dolan Darkest, with over 2 thousand comments.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
